entities.summary: Jeimer Candelario is an American professional baseball third baseman and first baseman for the Los Angeles Angels of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the Chicago Cubs, Detroit Tigers, Washington Nationals, and Cincinnati Reds. He has played for the Dominican Republic national baseball team.
